title: Soybean Yellow Mosaic Virus and Rust Disease Management
source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Soybean Research (IISR) & VNMKV Parbhani
summary: Yellow mosaic causes yellow patches and stunted growth, transmitted by whiteflies. Rust causes reddish-brown pustules on leaves during humid weather.
content: Symptoms of Yellow Mosaic: Alternate yellow and green patches on young trifoliate leaves, vein clearing, small pod formation. Transmitted by Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci). Symptoms of Rust (Phakopsora pachyrhizi): Tiny brown to dark brown pustules on undersides of leaves, premature defoliation under high humidity (>80%) and 20-25°C. Immediate Low-Risk Actions: 1) Rogue out severely infected yellow plants within 30 days of sowing and bury them to stop vector spread. 2) Install yellow sticky traps @ 15-20 traps/acre to trap whiteflies. 3) For whitefly control, spray 5% NSKE (Neem Seed Kernel Extract) or Azadirachtin 10000 ppm @ 2 ml/L water. 4) If vector density is high, spray Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 2 g/10L water or Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 2 g/10L water. 5) For Soybean Rust at initial pustule appearance, spray Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 1 ml/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L. Do not spray during windy hours or peak bee foraging.
